name: Parallax photo
description: A photo in two layers moved by a shared camera: the person in front comes closer faster than the background behind (2.5D, a Ken Burns move with depth).
description_de: Ein Foto in zwei Ebenen, bewegt von einer gemeinsamen Kamera: die Person vorn kommt schneller näher als der Hintergrund dahinter (2,5D, Ken-Burns-Fahrt mit Tiefe).
description_en: A photo in two layers moved by a shared camera: the person in front comes closer faster than the background behind (2.5D, a Ken Burns move with depth).
note: Cut the person out once: {op:'cutout_node', clip, node:3} (needs the 'cutout' extension); until then the photo moves as one layer. The camera (node 6) drifts slowly forward and to the right from the clip's start (drift_push, drift_x per second); keyframes on comp.n6.pan_x / push work too. The background keeps the person (no fill): keep the move small, or put the person in the middle.

push.description: how fast the camera moves forward, share of the distance per second (0.03: slow)

pan_x.description: how fast it moves right, picture widths per second (negative: left)

pan_y.description: how fast it moves down, picture heights per second (negative: up)

depth.description: distance of the background (the person stands at 1; larger = more parallax)

overscan.description: both layers this much bigger, so the move shows no edge (1.08)
